title: Preprocessing specification and pipeline validation

input_contract.normalization: not applied in this stage; specify and version before training
input_contract.frame_order: preserve numeric filename/frame order; never shuffle within a sequence
input_contract.sequence_sampling: must be fixed before comparative experiments

notes: This stage does not train or extract embeddings.
Grayscale conversion preserves intensity levels as uint8 but may convert a source mode to grayscale.
No thresholding, cropping, resizing, normalization, or augmentation is applied here.
Stage 3 readability checks do not prove semantic silhouette correctness.
